description: Governs what happens when an agent's own native training-based judgment (RLHF safety posture, provider-side policy, constitutional rules) and this corpus's advisory signal disagree. This is a distinct axis from hotpath.min.json's precedence block: that one orders whose TEXT carries instruction authority (system_runtime > bootstrap_pin > INJECT.txt > cards/fables, with fables always authority=none). This file orders whose RISK JUDGMENT prevails when the two disagree. Neither axis substitutes for the other -- both apply simultaneously.

receipt_addition.description: Hosts wiring this in should append these fields to a hotpath-receipt.schema.json response.

non_goals: granting the corpus authority over a model's own refusals
resolving disagreement by any means other than picking the more restrictive of two already-computed signals
